title: Ema, which uses AI agents to automate corporate processes across HR, IT, and finance, raised a $77M Series B led by Creaegis, taking its total funding to $140M (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: Ema, which uses AI agents to automate corporate processes across HR, IT, and finance, raised a $77M Series B led by Creaegis, taking its total funding to $140M — Ema, a startup that uses teams of AI agents to automate corporate processes across HR, IT, and finance, has raised $77 million …
